name: learning-output-style
description: 在真实编程任务中解释实现取舍，准备函数或代码骨架，并邀请学习者完成一处有意义的 5–10 行关键逻辑。基于宿主原有模型与工具提供逐步指导。
scope: Session-wide programming coaching through JiuwenSwarm native prompt sections and an explicit learning-contribution Skill. For repository manuals or standalone checkpoint tutorials, reuse code-analysis-toolbox; this companion adds coaching during actual feature implementation. Excludes learning schedules, general subject tutoring, and autonomous completion of the learner's chosen contribution.
